en.cone.tooltip.direction: Apply this grade or undo it using the same settings and peak.
en.cone.tooltip.anchor_j_center: Set the saturation at this tonal anchor where the local lightness slope returns to one. J uses chroma after the C edit.
en.cone.tooltip.anchor_c_center: Set the saturation at this tonal anchor where C Contrast changes direction. The crossover blends smoothly between tonal anchors.
en.tone_fit.tooltip.blackCompression: Apply reversible near-black compression before tone calibration. Zero bypasses the compression.
en.tone_fit.tooltip.hkInfluence: Blend tone mapping based on lightness alone (0) with the full chroma-aware H-K response (1). Both preserve saturation and hue.
en.tone_fit.tooltip.direction: Apply the integrated tone and chroma grade, or undo it using the same settings and peak.
en.cone.tooltip.gain_j_contrast: Expand or compress local lightness spacing in stops. Lightness and chroma scale together to preserve saturation. The effect fades near gray.
en.cone.tooltip.gain_c_gain: Increase or decrease chroma in stops at this tonal anchor. The effect fades near gray.
en.global_shape.tooltip.jContrast: Adjust the lightness slope at J Pivot in stops. Positive values darken below the pivot and brighten above it within the contrast range.
en.global_shape.tooltip.jPivot: Set the lightness magnitude held fixed by J Contrast, J Toe, and J Shoulder.
en.global_shape.tooltip.jToe: Lift or lower the dark end of the lightness curve while holding J Pivot fixed.
en.global_shape.tooltip.jShoulder: Lift or lower the bright end of the lightness curve while holding J Pivot fixed.
en.global_shape.tooltip.jSaturationBias: Favor vivid colors with positive values and muted colors with negative values. Zero applies the lightness curve equally at every saturation.
en.global_shape.tooltip.cContrast: Adjust the saturation slope at C Pivot in stops. Positive values subdue muted colors and enrich vivid colors within the contrast range.
en.global_shape.tooltip.cPivot: Set the saturation held fixed by C Contrast, C Muted, and C Vivid.
en.global_shape.tooltip.cMuted: Enrich or subdue colors below C Pivot while holding the pivot fixed.
en.global_shape.tooltip.cVivid: Enrich or subdue colors above C Pivot while holding the pivot fixed.
en.global_shape.tooltip.shadowChroma: Increase or decrease chroma in stops below C Tone Crossover. The effect fades near gray and toward the crossover.
en.global_shape.tooltip.highlightChroma: Increase or decrease chroma in stops above C Tone Crossover. The effect fades near gray and toward the crossover.
en.global_shape.tooltip.cToneCrossover: Set the lightness magnitude where both tonal chroma gains reach zero.
en.global_shape.tooltip.direction: Apply this grade or undo it using the same settings.
en.surface.tooltip.JContrast: Set the local stretch of signed lightness in stops at this tonal anchor. Positive amounts expand the lightness spacing of colors above the J saturation center and compress it below.
en.tooltip.warp.scale: Set local radial stretch in stops at this tone and destination hue. It scales lightness and chroma together and fades near gray. Lower-tone edits carry into brighter colors.
en.tooltip.warp.center_a: Set the a destination of this tone’s neutral. Adaptance preserves signed lightness and slows as chroma increases.
en.tooltip.warp.center_b: Set the b destination of this tone’s neutral. Adaptance preserves signed lightness and slows as chroma increases.
en.tooltip.color.adaptance_half_saturation: Set the saturation C/|J_A| where instantaneous tint speed falls to half its neutral value. The neutral still reaches the selected a/b target.

zh_HANS.cone.tooltip.direction: 应用此调色，或使用相同的设置和峰值逆转此调色。
zh_HANS.cone.tooltip.anchor_j_center: 设置此调域锚点的局部明度斜率等于 1 时的饱和度。明度调整使用彩度调整后的彩度。
zh_HANS.cone.tooltip.anchor_c_center: 设置此调域锚点的彩度对比改变方向时的饱和度。此中心值在调域锚点之间平滑过渡。
zh_HANS.tone_fit.tooltip.blackCompression: 在影调标定前对近黑区域应用可逆压缩。零值停用压缩。
zh_HANS.tone_fit.tooltip.hkInfluence: 在仅依据明度的影调映射（0）与考虑彩度的完整 H-K 响应（1）之间混合。两者均保持饱和度和色相。
zh_HANS.tone_fit.tooltip.direction: 应用整合后的影调和彩度调色，或使用相同设置和峰值逆转它。
zh_HANS.cone.tooltip.gain_j_contrast: 以档为单位展开或压缩局部明度间距。明度和彩度同比缩放以保持饱和度，效果在近灰色处逐渐减弱。
zh_HANS.cone.tooltip.gain_c_gain: 以档为单位增加或减少此调域锚点的彩度。效果在近灰色处逐渐减弱。
zh_HANS.global_shape.tooltip.jContrast: 以档为单位调整明度枢轴处的曲线斜率。在对比调整范围内，正值压暗枢轴以下的颜色，提亮枢轴以上的颜色。
zh_HANS.global_shape.tooltip.jPivot: 设置明度对比、明度趾部和明度肩部调整中保持固定的明度绝对值。
zh_HANS.global_shape.tooltip.jToe: 提高或降低明度曲线的暗端，同时保持明度枢轴固定。
zh_HANS.global_shape.tooltip.jShoulder: 提高或降低明度曲线的亮端，同时保持明度枢轴固定。
zh_HANS.global_shape.tooltip.jSaturationBias: 正值侧重高饱和色，负值侧重低饱和色。零值对各种饱和度的颜色应用相同的明度曲线。
zh_HANS.global_shape.tooltip.cContrast: 以档为单位调整彩度枢轴处的饱和度斜率。在对比调整范围内，正值降低低饱和色的彩度，提高高饱和色的彩度。
zh_HANS.global_shape.tooltip.cPivot: 设置彩度对比、低饱和彩度和高饱和彩度调整中保持固定的饱和度。
zh_HANS.global_shape.tooltip.cMuted: 提高或降低彩度枢轴以下颜色的彩度，同时保持枢轴固定。
zh_HANS.global_shape.tooltip.cVivid: 提高或降低彩度枢轴以上颜色的彩度，同时保持枢轴固定。
zh_HANS.global_shape.tooltip.shadowChroma: 以档为单位增加或减少调域交界以下的彩度。效果在近灰色和接近调域交界时逐渐减弱。
zh_HANS.global_shape.tooltip.highlightChroma: 以档为单位增加或减少调域交界以上的彩度。效果在近灰色和接近调域交界时逐渐减弱。
zh_HANS.global_shape.tooltip.cToneCrossover: 设置阴影和高光彩度增益都降为零的明度绝对值。
zh_HANS.global_shape.tooltip.direction: 应用此调色，或使用相同设置逆转此调色。
zh_HANS.surface.tooltip.JContrast: 以档为单位设置此调域锚点的有符号明度局部拉伸量。正值扩大饱和度高于 J 中心的颜色的明度间距，并压缩低于该中心的颜色的明度间距。
zh_HANS.tooltip.warp.scale: 以档为单位设置此调域和目标色相的局部径向拉伸量。明度和彩度同比缩放，近灰色处逐渐减弱。较暗调域的调整也会影响较亮的颜色。
zh_HANS.tooltip.warp.center_a: 设置此调域中性色的 a 目标值。白偏调整保持有符号明度，彩度越高，调整速度越慢。
zh_HANS.tooltip.warp.center_b: 设置此调域中性色的 b 目标值。白偏调整保持有符号明度，彩度越高，调整速度越慢。
zh_HANS.tooltip.color.adaptance_half_saturation: 设置瞬时白偏调整速度降至中性色一半时的饱和度 C/|J_A|。中性色仍会到达指定的 a/b 目标。
